lines.speaker: nurse_angela
lines.text: Okay, it's nine thirty, everybody's here. Let's do it. I've got the checklist up, I'll just walk it top to bottom and you stop me if anything's wrong.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Sounds good. Go for it.

lines.speaker: nurse_angela
lines.text: Build is signed, store listing is updated, the release notes are the ones Juliet wrote Tuesday, with the known issues section. Crash reporting is on. Support has the FAQ. That's all green.

lines.speaker: nurse_angela
lines.text: Next one is the Android 11 crash. Tybalt, that's closed, right?

lines.speaker: tybalt_capulet
lines.text: Closed. That was the photo-cache path thing, fixed Wednesday. We haven't seen it come back on any of the older devices since.

lines.speaker: nurse_angela
lines.text: Great. And then the airplane-mode test. That's the one I really want to hear about.

lines.speaker: tybalt_capulet
lines.text: So, um, it passed. I ran it overnight on three tablets. Airplane mode on, did twelve inspections each, photos, findings, signatures, the whole thing. Then turned the radios back on this morning and everything synced. No duplicates, no lost photos.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Twelve each? That's more than I expected.

lines.speaker: tybalt_capulet
lines.text: I said it had to survive a week of airplane mode. I didn't have a week, so I gave it volume instead.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Ha. Fair. I'll take it.

lines.speaker: tybalt_capulet
lines.text: And to be clear, that's Balcony on its own. I also ran it with the queue build Romeo merged, and that held too. I'm, honestly, I'm a lot less worried than I was Monday.

lines.speaker: nurse_angela
lines.text: Noted, and I'm writing that down, because I don't hear it often. Okay. Balthasar, QA sign-off.

lines.speaker: balthasar_davi
lines.text: Yeah. So the offline-sync conflict fix is solid. I re-ran it yesterday afternoon on all six devices again, just to be paranoid, and it holds. The only thing left is the one I mentioned yesterday, the photo upload on slow networks.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: The flaky one.

lines.speaker: balthasar_davi
lines.text: Right. On a really bad connection, like one bar in a yard, a photo upload can stall and then retry. It does get there. It just takes a while and the progress bar looks stuck. Nothing gets lost.

lines.speaker: nurse_angela
lines.text: And it's documented?

lines.speaker: balthasar_davi
lines.text: It's in the known issues now, I added a line to the notes this morning. So, from me, it's a sign-off. Not a blocker.

lines.speaker: nurse_angela
lines.text: Okay. Then that's the last line on the checklist. Everything's green except one documented known issue. Juliet, it's your call.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Okay. Um, anyone want to argue for no-go? Seriously, now's the time.

lines.speaker: tybalt_capulet
lines.text: Not me.

lines.speaker: balthasar_davi
lines.text: No, I'm good.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Then it's a go. But let's stage it. Ten percent on Monday, we watch crash rates and the sync numbers for a few days, and if it's quiet we go to a hundred percent on Thursday.

lines.speaker: nurse_angela
lines.text: Ten Monday, a hundred Thursday. I like that. Gives us the weekend to breathe, too.

lines.speaker: tybalt_capulet
lines.text: I'll keep an eye on the dashboards Monday and Tuesday. If the Android numbers twitch, I'll say something.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Perfect. Balthasar, can you keep a couple of the slow-network devices handy next week, just in case?

lines.speaker: balthasar_davi
lines.text: Yeah, they're not going anywhere.

lines.speaker: nurse_angela
lines.text: Okay, so I'll send the announcement this morning. Internal first, then the note to the beta testers, then I'll schedule the store rollout for Monday at ten percent.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Thank you, Angela. And thanks, all of you. This was a good week. Really.

lines.speaker: nurse_angela
lines.text: Don't jinx it. Go do your Ducal thing.
